chunks: I asked Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him): Is staying in Mecca superior, or going out to some of the cities? He (peace be upon him) wrote: 'Staying near the House of God is superior.'

key_terms.الْمُقَامُ: Staying or remaining in a place

ai.seo_question: What is the preferred state for a believer: staying in Mecca or traveling to other cities?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this hadith features Ali ibn Mahziyar asking Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) whether it is more virtuous to remain in Mecca or travel to other regions. The Imam’s written reply affirms that staying near the House of God (Bayt Allah) holds superior merit, emphasizing the spiritual centrality of the Kaaba in Shia jurisprudence and devotion.
